title: Architect
description:
**Company Description** 
 Creo Homes Pvt Ltd is a leading architectural design and turnkey construction company based in Kochi, Kerala, dedicated to redefining luxury home design and delivery. The organization brings together architects, engineers, interior designers, and skilled craftsmen to create personalized living spaces that reflect each client’s aspirations. Covering architecture, construction, interiors, and landscaping under one roof, Creo Homes offers a seamless, end\-to\-end project experience from concept to completion. Every project is guided by a commitment to creativity, quality, ethics, and customer satisfaction, with a strong focus on responsibility and respect. With an ambitious growth plan to expand to 20 cities across India by 2035, the company continues to invest in innovation, robust systems, and a client\-first culture.
   

  

**Role Description**
 We are looking for a creative, experienced, and detail\-oriented Architect to lead residential projects from initial concept through design development and execution. The ideal candidate should have strong architectural and technical knowledge, excellent communication and client\-handling skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with consultants, contractors, and project teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Residential Design \& Concept Development** 
 : Develop innovative and functional architectural concepts for residential projects based on client requirements, site conditions, budget, and project objectives.
   

  

**Architectural Drawings \& Documentation:** 
 Prepare detailed floor plans, elevations, sections, layouts, working drawings, and construction documentation using AutoCAD and other relevant design software.
   

  

**Client Coordination:** 
 Understand client requirements, present design concepts, incorporate feedback, and maintain effective communication throughout the project.
   

  

**Consultant \& Team Coordination:** 
 Coordinate with structural, MEP, interior, landscape, and other consultants to ensure all design elements are properly integrated.
   

  

**Regulatory Compliance:** 
 Ensure architectural designs comply with applicable building codes, local development regulations, zoning requirements, and permit guidelines.
   

  

**Site Visits \& Execution Support** 
 : Conduct regular site inspections, monitor work against approved drawings, and provide technical solutions and clarifications to the execution team.
   

  

**Design \& Quality Control:** 
 Review drawings, materials, finishes, and construction details to ensure the project meets required design standards and quality expectations.
   

  

**Project Coordination:** 
 Work closely with project managers, contractors, engineers, and site teams to ensure smooth execution and timely completion of project milestones.
   

  

**Requirements**
 B.Arch degree (COA registration preferred).
   

  

**Minimum 3 Years Of Experience In Residential Architecture.**
 Proficiency in AutoCAD.
   

  

 Strong communication, presentation, and project coordination skills.
   

  

 Knowledge of local building rules and permit procedures.
   

  

 Location: Candidates must be based in Kochi or willing to relocate before joining
   

  

**Benefits**
 Cell phone reimbursement
   

  

 Internet reimbursement
   

  

 Provident Fund
   

  

 Work Location: In person
